In a world where humanity is being preyed upon, the player who becomes the last chef leads demons and adventurers to hunt monsters and run a restaurant using the ingredients he obtains. You can also enjoy roguelite elements and a romance with a demon.

items.summary: CDPROJEKTREDは2026年第3四半期の決算説明会で，「TheWitcherIV」は「GTA5」から「GTA6」への飛躍に匹敵する進化を目指すと説明した。「Cyberpunk2」の開発陣も拡充しており，複数の大型RPGを並行して，従来より短期間で開発できる体制を目指している。

zh.title: 《巫师 IV》旨在实现媲美《GTA 6》的飞跃 CD PROJEKT RED 将缩短大型 RPG 的开发周期
zh.summary: CDPROJEKTRED在2026年第三季度的财务业绩说明会上解释说，《巫师IV》的目标是进化以匹配从《GTA5》到《GTA6》的飞跃。《赛博朋克2》的开发团队也扩大了，我们的目标是建立一个能够在比以前更短的时间内并行开发多个大型RPG的系统。

en.title: ``The Witcher IV'' aims to make a leap forward comparable to ``GTA 6.'' CD PROJEKT RED will shorten the development cycle of large RPGs
en.summary: CDPROJEKTRED explained at the financial results briefing for the third quarter of 2026 that ``The Witcher IV'' aims to evolve to match the leap from ``GTA5'' to ``GTA6.'' The development team for "Cyberpunk 2" has also been expanded, and we are aiming for a system that allows us to develop multiple large-scale RPGs in parallel in a shorter period of time than before.

Here's what's new: New Market Homepage We've redesigned the Market Homepage to load faster and show users the most relevant items in their game. The "Popular Items" section contains just a few of the millions of items available and remains consistent year-round, while items that are rising in popularity give users a peek at what's new in the games they're currently playing. Game links have been moved to the top and personalized, so users no longer see a static list of priorities and can quickly access the items they are most likely to be interested in.

items.title: 许多人批评《GTA 6》，但这重要吗？

ja.title: GTA 6 を批判する人はたくさんいますが、それは問題でしょうか?
ja.summary: 発売以来、世論に激しい嵐を巻き起こした『GTA 6』。 『GTA 6』に対する批判は大きく2つに分けられる。一つは社会レベルからのものです。多くの人がこのゲームのプロットに不満を持っています。彼らは、ゲームの男性主人公ジェイソンには個性がなく、ヒロインの性格が煩わしいと考えており、それが一連​​の批判を引き起こした。 2つ目はゲームデザインそのものの側面です。一部のプレイヤーは、このゲームは退屈すぎて、プレイヤーが「GTA の感覚」を見つけるのを妨げていると考えています。社会レベルでは、このゲームがこれほど大きな世間の反発を引き起こした理由の 1 つは、GTA が純粋なゲームの領域を超えて「文化現象」になったことです。 「GTA 6」がリリースされてから 1 か月で、ほぼすべてのメディア、インターネットの有名人、フォーラムがこれに注目し、その結果、実際のトラフィック パスワードとなりました。多くのユーザーはゲームのライブ中継やアンカーによるゲームレビューを見てゲームに対する認識を築き上げており、ゲームに対して否定的な感情を抱いている人も少なくありません。

en.title: Many people criticized GTA 6, but does it matter?
en.summary: "GTA 6" has set off a fierce storm of public opinion since its release. Criticisms of "GTA 6" can be roughly divided into two parts. One is from the social level. Many people are dissatisfied with the plot of this game. They believe that the male protagonist Jason of the game lacks personality and the heroine's character is annoying, which triggered a series of criticisms. The second is the game design aspect itself. Some players think this game is too boring and prevents players from finding the "GTA feeling". On a social level, one of the reasons why the game has caused such a major public outcry is that GTA has transcended the realm of pure gaming and has become a "cultural phenomenon." In the month after "GTA 6" was released, almost all media, Internet celebrities and forums paid attention to it, which resulted in it becoming a real traffic password. A large number of users build their perception of the game by watching live game broadcasts or game reviews by anchors, and many people have negative feelings about the game.
